patch.value: Add bounded real-time Jellyfin event streaming

Expose Jellyfin 10.11.11 WebSocket notifications through a safe, bounded, agent-optimized CLI surface outside the REST OpenAPI contract, with deterministic filtering, keepalive handling, structured streaming formats, schemas, docs, and read-only live validation.

jf events exposes discoverable help and machine-readable event-type metadata based on the current official Jellyfin WebSocket protocol; jf events watch authenticates without logging credentials, handles ForceKeepAlive, filters message types, and exits deterministically by count, duration, timeout, or signal; streaming output is validated and automation-safe, with NDJSON as the multi-record contract and bounded JSON/TOON alternatives where appropriate; unit, integration, portable, built-CLI, secret, changelog, package, and read-only live tests pass without mutating Jellyfin data
Latest stable release, exact official server protocol, official TypeScript SDK behavior, live 10.11.11 setup, PM duplicates, and existing command architecture have been inspected.
Give agents a low-latency source of Jellyfin state changes instead of polling REST endpoints.
Adds the major API surface omitted by OpenAPI while preserving privacy, bounded execution, and server safety.
A production-ready jf events command family with protocol-correct subscriptions and deterministic automation contracts.
The existing CLI maps every live REST operation, so WebSocket notifications are the clearest current API-parity gap.
AI review agents and repository checks

value.decision: Implement the transport with the Node/Bun standards-compatible WebSocket API rather than adding the full Jellyfin SDK runtime dependency.
value.rationale: The CLI needs a small streaming boundary, while the official SDK source remains the protocol reference. A native adapter preserves package size, explicit bounds, and full control of redaction/output without guessing types.
value.evidence: Jellyfin v10.11.11 server message classes and @jellyfin/sdk 0.13.0 WebSocketService/constants inspected on 2026-07-27.

value.author: codex-jellyfin-realtime
value.text: Implementation boundary: passive server notifications and the three official periodic read subscriptions only. No playback/control messages will be sent, all live acceptance uses JELLYFIN_READ_ONLY=1, and no raw event payloads or identifiers will be persisted in PM or Git.

value.author: codex-jellyfin-realtime
value.text: Streaming contract will use one JSON object per line for ndjson and bounded aggregate envelopes for other structured formats. Credentials are supplied only through the existing config resolver and must never appear in URLs, explanations, errors, fixtures, or snapshots.
